plain_description.what: On a union of six benchmarks (21,606 questions, 18 open models), it picks the best model per benchmark or per subject on the training side, and compares accuracy on the held-out side with the best single model and with a perfect per-question oracle. Answer keys only.
plain_description.why: Asks whether a multi-benchmark mix has anything to gain from routing, after MMLU-Pro alone showed none.
plain_description.information: A real gain justifies the routing line of the thesis. Result: yes, there is something to route. Routing by benchmark or by subject gains about 4 to 5 points over the best single model (0.553), and this is beyond noise. A MATH answer-formatting artefact inflated this, and after the fix the gain is about +2.7 points. The perfect oracle (0.907) is a ceiling, not a reachable target. On MMLU-Pro alone the gain is zero.
